readerValues.programmeDescription: Leiden’s bachelor in Latin American Studies combines Spanish or Portuguese with the study of Latin American history, politics, languages, literature and film. The degree develops regional research skills. Its language goals are C1 for reading and B2 for listening, speaking and writing. The first-year courses shown here illustrate the Spanish language choice.
readerValues.comparisonExplanation: The displayed 90 EC comprises the confirmed 60 EC first year and 30 EC of elective space. The allocation and sequence of the remaining 90 required EC for 2026 entrants still need confirmation, including the taught courses around second-year study abroad. A complete comparison with UCR remains unfinished.

curriculum.limitation: Verified subset: 90 of 180 EC. The eight first-year courses total 60 EC; a further 30 EC is elective space. Leiden says 2026 entrants will study abroad in the first semester of year two, while the annual table still uses the earlier second-semester arrangement. The remaining 90 required EC and their sequence await confirmation.
